subject: Mutual action plan: acceptance signals, exit gates, and QA test ledger
messages:
From: Alyssa Wong <alyssa.wong@veridianhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP + acceptance asks for evaluation

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the latency improvements and the model's handling of clinical extraction prompts. Procurement asked me to send an initial mutual action plan so we can lock timelines and acceptance criteria. Attached is a one-page MAP (MAP_v1.pdf) with proposed milestones.

High-level asks from Veridian:
- Clear pass/fail signals for the evaluation (what constitutes a pass)
- A concrete exit gate checklist we can use to greenlight production traffic
- Acceptance tests we can run on our sample prompt set and an agreed scoring method
- A target close timeline so legal/procurement can schedule reviews

Proposed acceptance signals (initial):
- P95 inference latency <= 400ms for the 512-token baseline
- Intent/slot extraction accuracy >= 95% on our curated 500-record set
- Hallucination rate (critical entity misses or fabrications) < 3%
- No PII leakage in request/response samples (SOC2 evidence will be required)

Can you confirm Redwood's proposed test harness (unit tests + 500-sample regression set) and whether you can provide a runbook for the smoke/stress runs? Also please include who will own the canary and rollback triggers.

We need a MAP that procurement can attach to the SOW; can you share an acceptance matrix (CSV) with exact fields?

Thanks,
Alyssa Wong
Head of Platform Integrations
Veridian Health

-- Attachment: MAP_v1.pdf (one-page MAP summary)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Wong <alyssa.wong@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance asks for evaluation

Alyssa — thanks for the clear list. Marking up the acceptance signals below and proposing exact pass thresholds so procurement and legal can bake them into the SOW. I attached an acceptance-matrix.csv with column headers and example rows.

Redwood suggested acceptance ledger (draft):
- Latency: P95 <= 350ms for 512-token baseline, measured over a 24-hour production-like run with 5% burst traffic
- Throughput: sustain 100 reqs/sec for sustained window with <1% 5xx errors
- Accuracy: intent/slot F1 >= 96% on Veridian 500-sample eval set (gold labels to be shared under NDA)
- Hallucination: critical entity hallucination rate < 2% (measured by a team-blinded review of 200 fails)
- Safety/PII: zero instances of PII leakage in 1k sample audit; SOC2-compatible logging and redaction in place
- Cost: token cost requirement — target median cost per 1k tokens <= $6 (for budgeting; negotiable in final pricing)

Canary and rollback plan (high level):
- Canary traffic at 1% user traffic for 24 hours with active monitoring on latency, error rate, hallucination signals; automatic rollback if hallucination rate > 2.5% or P95 latency increases by >30% vs baseline
- Post-canary verification: run the regression set and check pass thresholds before moving to 10% -> 50% -> 100% rollout

We can provide: test harness (docker run), a pre-populated regression bucket, and a simple script to compute the metrics above. I will own the test harness delivery and the canary automation; Ben will own rollout ops.

Next steps requested from Veridian: share the gold-label eval set and confirm which three intents are critical (we will prioritize those in the first sprint). Also confirm the legal timeline for sign-off so we can align the MAP dates.

-Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

-- Attachment: acceptance-matrix.csv (headers: metric,threshold,measurement_method,owner,notes)
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Wong <alyssa.wong@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance asks for evaluation

Alyssa / Karthik — appreciate the quick turn here. A few product/ops guardrails from my side to make the MAP production-ready:

1) Raise the bar on core intents: set F1 >= 98% for the three critical intents Veridian identifies. Secondary intents can remain at 95% as a stretch target.
2) Add an explicit data handling exit gate: SOC2 evidence for log retention + consent controls must be provided before canary.
3) Evaluation sprint cadence: propose a three-week sprint (Week 1: onboarding & baseline runs; Week 2: targeted tuning + regression; Week 3: canary & verification).
4) Final signoff: designate a single PO from Veridian and a Redwood exec sponsor to approve the pass/fail matrix at the end of Week 3.

Ben — can you take the rollout checklist and add the monitoring playbook and runbook tasks? We should also list owner for each acceptance metric in the CSV.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Alyssa Wong <alyssa.wong@veridianhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@veridianhealth.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance asks for evaluation

Thanks — that looks reasonable. A few notes from procurement/legal:
- Veridian can accept the three-week sprint, but we need the MAP table-style (dates, owners, acceptance thresholds) for the SOW attachment. Please populate dates for Week 1/2/3 and provide an estimated calendar for signoff: target final review by Friday, July 9, 2027.
- We need a short data-retention clause and audit-log access details. Can Redwood provide the audit-log schema and retention guarantees (even if via a short attachment)?
- Attachment: procurement-q.pdf contains the procurement team's questions; the team expects a short turnaround (48 hours) on those items.

Alyssa Wong
Head of Platform Integrations
Veridian Health

-- Attachment: procurement-q.pdf (procurement Qs + placeholders for K1/K2 responses)

Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance asks for evaluation

Copy — I'll own the canary rollout and the monitoring playbook. Action items I will do by Friday:
- Populate the rollout checklist with metric owners and thresholds (add to acceptance-matrix.csv)
- Prepare an ops runbook with automated rollback triggers and PagerDuty playbook
- Share a short readme describing how to run the regression harness locally

One-line confirmation to Veridian: Redwood will deliver the acceptance matrix and the audit-log schema in the next 48 hours for procurement review.

Ben Carter
